# Transitions

Test fixture: a Reading and Writing page. Name the relationship between
the two sentences *before* reading the choices.

## Logical transitions {#logical-transition}

| Relationship | Transitions |
| --- | --- |
| contrast | however, nevertheless, by contrast |
| addition | moreover, furthermore, likewise |
| cause and result | therefore, consequently, as a result |

> **Example.** The trail was steep. ______, most hikers reached the top
> before noon.
>
> The second sentence is surprising given the first, so the blank needs
> contrast: **Nevertheless**.

> **Fails when:** both sentences support the same claim; then contrast
> words are wrong even if the tone shifts.

## Sentence connection {#sentence-connection}

> **Example.** The museum extended its hours; ______, attendance rose by
> a third.
>
> The rise follows from the change, so the answer is a result word:
> *consequently*.

See [the rhetorical synthesis page](learn:sat-reading-writing/expression-of-ideas/rhetorical-synthesis)
for questions built from notes.
